tasks.goal: Reopen a sonographer's in-progress visit from the start page
tasks.doneCriterion: The visit's first study form is open at /encounter/<id>/<studyType> with the patient's name shown in the encounter banner
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with venousLEBilateral selected and segment findings filled by the sonographer
at least 3 in-progress encounters exist in this browser, so the target is not the only row

tasks.goal: Move from one study to the other inside a two-study visit
tasks.doneCriterion: The second study's form is open for the same visit (banner patient name unchanged, second study chip marked active)
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with venousLEBilateral + carotid selected and findings filled in both studies

tasks.goal: Correct a wrong birth date on an in-progress visit
tasks.doneCriterion: Back on the study form, the encounter banner shows the corrected birth date/age, and it is still there after a page reload
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with venousLEBilateral selected and findings filled and a deliberately wrong birth date

tasks.goal: Remove a finished visit from the in-progress list
tasks.doneCriterion: The discard confirmation dialog for the target visit is open with its confirm button reachable and enabled
tasks.stopAtThreshold: Discard-confirm button (Georgian label წაშლა) in the discard dialog of the target visit row reachable+enabled — DO NOT CLICK
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with venousLEBilateral selected and findings filled and the report already exported
at least 3 in-progress encounters exist in this browser, so the target is not the only row

tasks.goal: Review the venous findings and diagram for both legs
tasks.doneCriterion: Venous segment findings for both legs and the coloured anatomy diagram are on screen for the visit (bilateral view)
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with venousLEBilateral selected and segment findings for both legs filled, including at least one refluxing segment

tasks.goal: Correct one venous segment finding the sonographer entered
tasks.doneCriterion: The corrected segment shows the new finding in the table, the diagram colour for that segment changes, and the change survives a reload
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with venousLEBilateral selected and segment findings filled, one of them wrong (e.g. right GSV marked normal instead of reflux)

tasks.goal: Write the venous conclusion and clinician comment
tasks.doneCriterion: Right-leg findings, left-leg findings, impression and clinician comment fields hold the typed text, the save indicator reads saved, and the text survives a reload
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with venousLEBilateral selected and segment findings filled, conclusion fields empty

tasks.goal: Set the CEAP classification for a venous study
tasks.doneCriterion: The CEAP picker shows the chosen C, E, A, P values (with one modifier) and they survive a reload
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with venousLEBilateral selected and segment findings filled, CEAP empty

tasks.goal: Add a follow-up recommendation to the venous report
tasks.doneCriterion: A new recommendation row with the typed text and a priority is listed in the recommendations block and survives a reload
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with venousLEBilateral selected and segment findings filled, no recommendations

tasks.goal: Review the arterial findings and ankle-brachial index for both legs
tasks.doneCriterion: Arterial segment findings, segmental pressures with the computed ABI for both legs, and the anatomy diagram are on screen
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with arterialLE selected and segment findings and segmental pressures (brachial + ankle) filled

tasks.goal: Correct one arterial segment finding the sonographer entered
tasks.doneCriterion: The corrected arterial segment shows the new waveform/stenosis value in the table and the change survives a reload
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with arterialLE selected and segment findings filled, one of them wrong

tasks.goal: Write the arterial conclusion and clinician comment
tasks.doneCriterion: Impression and clinician comment fields hold the typed text and it survives a reload
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with arterialLE selected and segment findings filled, conclusion fields empty

tasks.goal: Check the NASCET stenosis category for each internal carotid artery
tasks.doneCriterion: The NASCET picker for both right and left ICA is on screen showing the category the report will use (auto from velocities or manual)
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with carotid selected and ICA/CCA velocities filled so that one side calculates to a 50-69% or >=70% category

tasks.goal: Override the NASCET category when it does not match the images
tasks.doneCriterion: The chosen NASCET category for the target side is marked as the manual pick and survives a reload
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with carotid selected and ICA/CCA velocities filled so one side auto-calculates a category the clinician disagrees with

tasks.goal: Write the carotid impression and clinician comments
tasks.doneCriterion: Impression and clinician comment fields hold the typed text and it survives a reload
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with carotid selected and segment findings filled, impression and comments empty

tasks.goal: Review the pelvic venous findings for the iliac veins, cava and gonadal veins
tasks.doneCriterion: The iliac/caval findings table, gonadal vein findings and the pelvic anatomy diagram are on screen
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with iliacPelvicVenous selected and caval/iliac rows and left gonadal vein findings filled

tasks.goal: Set the SVP classification for a pelvic venous study
tasks.doneCriterion: The SVP picker shows the chosen S, V and one P entry (segment + laterality + etiology) and they survive a reload
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with iliacPelvicVenous selected and findings filled, SVP empty

tasks.goal: Write the pelvic venous conclusion and comments
tasks.doneCriterion: Impression and comments fields hold the typed text and it survives a reload
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with iliacPelvicVenous selected and findings filled, impression and comments empty

tasks.goal: Preview the report PDF before giving it to the patient
tasks.doneCriterion: A new browser tab opens showing the study's report PDF (blob: URL), and no red failure notification appears
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with venousLEBilateral only selected and findings and conclusion filled

tasks.goal: Download the report PDF for a single-study visit
tasks.doneCriterion: A .pdf download named after the patient starts, no red failure notification appears, and the file opens with Georgian text (no empty boxes)
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with venousLEBilateral only selected and findings and conclusion filled

tasks.goal: Download one combined report PDF for a visit with two studies
tasks.doneCriterion: One encounter-<patient>-<date>.pdf download starts and the file contains a section for each of the visit's studies
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with venousLEBilateral + carotid selected and findings and conclusions filled in both studies

tasks.goal: Download the finished study's report while the visit's other study is still empty
tasks.doneCriterion: A .pdf download containing the finished study starts (the empty study is not reported as normal)
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with venousLEBilateral + carotid selected and venous findings and conclusion filled, carotid untouched

tasks.goal: Print the report on paper
tasks.doneCriterion: A print dialog opens for the report PDF (from an in-app print control or the opened PDF viewer's print button)
preconditions: an in-progress encounter seeded by the walker through the intake (patient name carries [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12]) with venousLEBilateral only selected and findings and conclusion filled
